# ntfy-mac settings

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-cli-docs.swift from `ntfy-mac schema --json`. Do not edit; run `make docs`. -->

Every setting the app's Settings window shows has a command. A test fails when a setting has no command here, so the two cannot drift. The same list is in `ntfy-mac schema --json` under `settings`; the commands are described in the [CLI reference](cli.md).

Settings in `config.json` apply to the running app through its config watcher; no restart is needed.

## Server

| Setting | Lives in | Command | Example | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Server URL | config.json: `url` | `ntfy-mac setup` | `ntfy-mac setup --url https://ntfy.example.com --token tk_...` |  |
| Access token | Keychain | `ntfy-mac setup` | `ntfy-mac setup --url https://ntfy.example.com --token tk_...` |  |
| Allow the token over plain http | config.json: `allowInsecure` | `ntfy-mac config set` | `ntfy-mac config set allowInsecure true` |  |

## Topics

| Setting | Lives in | Command | Example | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Subscribe to a topic | config.json: `extraTopics` | `ntfy-mac subscribe` | `ntfy-mac subscribe builds` | `subscribe reset` clears every local addition. |
| Unsubscribe from a topic | config.json: `extraTopics` | `ntfy-mac unsubscribe` | `ntfy-mac unsubscribe builds` |  |
| Mute a topic | config.json: `topicSettings.<topic>.mute` | `ntfy-mac config topic set` | `ntfy-mac config topic set builds --mute` | `--unmute` undoes it; `config topic reset <topic>` clears all topic settings. |
| Minimum priority of a topic | config.json: `topicSettings.<topic>.minPriority` | `ntfy-mac config topic set` | `ntfy-mac config topic set builds --min-priority 4` | `--min-priority none` removes the filter. |
| Emoji of a topic | config.json: `topicSettings.<topic>.emoji` | `ntfy-mac config topic set` | `ntfy-mac config topic set builds --emoji 🔨` | `--emoji none` removes it. |

## Sounds and dismiss timing

| Setting | Lives in | Command | Example | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Sound per priority | config.json: `sounds` | `ntfy-mac config sounds set` | `ntfy-mac config sounds set 5 Sosumi` | `config sounds reset` restores the defaults; `silent` plays nothing. |
| Available sound names | System | `ntfy-mac sounds` (read only) | `ntfy-mac sounds` |  |
| Sound preview | System | UI only |  | Playing a sound is a UI affordance; the CLI tests a priority end to end with `notify`. |
| Auto-dismiss time per priority | config.json: `dismiss` | `ntfy-mac config dismiss set` | `ntfy-mac config dismiss set 3 15` | `never` keeps the notification; `config dismiss reset` restores the defaults. |

## Quiet hours

| Setting | Lives in | Command | Example | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Quiet hours on | config.json: `quietHours.enabled` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set --start 22:00 --end 07:00` | `set` turns it on; `config quiet-hours off` turns it off and keeps the times. |
| Quiet hours start | config.json: `quietHours.start` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set --start 22:00` |  |
| Quiet hours end | config.json: `quietHours.end` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set --end 07:00` |  |
| Urgent messages bypass quiet hours | config.json: `quietHours.urgentBypass` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set --no-urgent-bypass` |  |
| Digest when quiet hours end | config.json: `quietHours.digest` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set` | `ntfy-mac config quiet-hours set --no-digest` |  |

## System

| Setting | Lives in | Command | Example | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Open at login | System | `ntfy-mac login-item` | `ntfy-mac login-item on` |  |
| Pause notifications | config.json: `pausedUntil` | `ntfy-mac pause` | `ntfy-mac pause --for 30m` | `ntfy-mac resume` ends the pause. |
| Notification permission | System | `ntfy-mac status` (read only) | `ntfy-mac status --json` | macOS owns it; `doctor` explains what is missing. |
